

```{r}
library(ariadne)
library(curatedMetagenomicData)
```

## Functional module analysis at gene level

```{r}
# Load gene family experiment
genes <- curatedMetagenomicData("IjazUZ_2017.gene_families", dryrun = FALSE)

# Extract experiment
genes <- genes[[1]]

# Add uniref ids to rowData
rowData(genes)$UniRef90 <- rownames(genes)
```

```{r}
# Print experiment
genes
```

```{r}
gmm <- importModules("GMM")
```

```{r}
ko.uniref90 <- importMapping("ChocoPhlAn", "ko", "uniref90")
```

```{r}
# Map KOs of GMMs to UniRef90
modules <- mapModules(gmm[seq(10)], ko.uniref90, type = "andor")
```


```{r}
genes <- addModules(genes, modules, group = "UniRef90")
```

## Functional module analysis at taxon level

```{r}
# Load relative abundance experiment
tse <- curatedMetagenomicData("IjazUZ_2017.relative_abundance", dryrun = FALSE)

# Extract experiment
tse <- tse[[1]]
```


```{r}
modules <- mapModules(
    gmm[seq(10)],
    ko.uniref90,
    type = "andor",
    mode = "taxonomy"
)
```

```{r}
tse <- addModules(tse, modules)
```
